## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes locally (lint, code style, PHPStan, tests)
- [ ] New behaviour has tests (unit for logic, functional for endpoints)
- [ ] Database changes come with a generated migration (`make db-diff`)
- [ ] `docs/openapi.yaml` and `docs/api.md` updated if the API changed
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data in code, logs or tests
